"""
	Transforms the provided date value based on user-selected options for 
	period and shift.
	
	Args:
	    value (Date): The date value to transform.
	    quality (Quality): The quality of the data (not used in this function).
	    timestamp (Timestamp): The timestamp of the value (not used in this function).
	
	Returns:
	    Date: The transformed date based on the selected options.
	"""
	
	def set_datetime(year, month, day, hour, minute=0, second=0):
	    """Helper function to set the date and time."""
	    date = system.date.getDate(year, month, day)
	    return system.date.setTime(date, hour, minute, second)
	"""
	# Test hour
	value = set_datetime(2024, 9, 22, 15)
	print value
	shift = "B"
	dropDownPeriod = 5  # 0: Turno A, 1: Turno B, 2: Turno C, 3: Previous Day, 4: Current Day, 5: Weeks, 6: Months, 7: Custom
	endTime = set_datetime(2020, 10, 2, 21)
	"""
	
	Year = system.date.getYear(value)
	Month = system.date.getMonth(value)
	Day = system.date.getDayOfMonth(value)
	Hour = system.date.getHour24(value)
	Min = system.date.getMinute(value)
	
	
	# Variables to hold user selections
	endTime = self.getChild("root").getChild("Filters").getChild("DateTimeInput_EndTime").props.value
	shift = self.custom.shift
	dropDownPeriod = self.getChild("root").getChild("Filters").getChild("Dropdown Periodo").props.value
	
	
	# Process the selected period
	if dropDownPeriod == 7:  # Custom selected
	    value = endTime
	
	elif dropDownPeriod == 0:  # Selecting Shift A
	    if shift == 'C':
	        value = set_datetime(Year, Month, Day-1, 5, 59, 59)  # End of Shift A
	    elif shift == 'B':
	        value = set_datetime(Year, Month, Day, 5, 59, 59)  # End of Shift A (when switching from Shift B)
	    elif shift == 'A':
	        if Hour < 6:  # In Shift C between 0:00 and 5:59
	            value = set_datetime(Year, Month, Day, 5, 59, 59)  # End of previous Shift A
	        else:
	            value = set_datetime(Year, Month, Day+1, 5, 59, 59)  # Current Shift A end time
	
	elif dropDownPeriod == 1:  # Selecting Shift B
	    if shift == 'C':
	        value = set_datetime(Year, Month, Day, 13, 59, 59)  # End of previous Shift B
	    elif shift == 'B':
	        value = set_datetime(Year, Month, Day, 13, 59, 59)  # Current Shift B end time
	    elif shift == 'A':
	    	if Hour < 6:  
	        	value = set_datetime(Year, Month, Day -1 , 13, 59, 59)  # End Shift B
	        else:
	        	value = set_datetime(Year, Month, Day , 13, 59, 59)  # End Shift B
	
	elif dropDownPeriod == 2:  # Selecting Shift C
	    if shift == 'C':
	        value = set_datetime(Year, Month, Day, 21, 59, 59)  # End of Shift C
	    elif shift == 'B':
	        value = set_datetime(Year, Month, Day-1, 21, 59, 59)  # End of previous Shift C
	    elif shift == 'A':    	
	    	if Hour < 6:  
	        	value = set_datetime(Year, Month, Day -1 , 21, 59, 59)  # End Shift B
	        else:
	        	value = set_datetime(Year, Month, Day , 21, 59, 59)  # End Shift B
	
	elif dropDownPeriod == 3:  # Selecting Previous Day
	    if Hour < 6:  # If the current time is between 0:00 and 5:59
	        value = set_datetime(Year, Month, Day - 1, 5, 59, 59)  # End of previous day
	    else:
	        #value = set_datetime(Year, Month, Day, 5, 59, 59)  # End of current day
			value = system.date.now()
	else:  # Default case, just use the current hour and minute
	    #value = set_datetime(Year, Month, Day, Hour, Min, 0)
	    value = system.date.now()
	return value

    db = self.custom.dbConnection
    
    def _normalize_ip(ip):
        if ip and ip.startswith("::ffff:"):
            return ip.split(":")[-1]
        return (ip or "").strip()
    
    # Obtiene la información de la sesión actual
    sid = self.session.props.id  # id de la sesión del cliente
    session_info_list = system.perspective.getSessionInfo()
    
    # Buscar la sesión que coincide con este cliente
    sinfo = next((s for s in session_info_list if s.get("id") == sid), {})
    
    # Obtener la IP del cliente
    ip = _normalize_ip(sinfo.get("clientAddress", ""))
    return ip

        query = """
        		-- TEST
				WITH ranked AS (
				    SELECT 
				        rh.ID as RegisterID,
				        rh.Timestamp,
				        rh.Status,
				        rh.[User],
				        rh.DataAnswer,
				        rh.RegisterTypeID,
				        rh.RegisterCode,
				        rh.NodeID,
				        rh.PapoID,
				        rh.WorkstationNodeID,
				        rh.WorkstationID,
				        n.Name AS NodeName,
				        n.DisplayName AS NodeDisplayName,
				        n.Topic AS Path,
				        p.Reference AS PapoReference,
				        p.Description AS PapoDescription,
				        w.Description AS WorkstationDescription,
				                    
				        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
				            PARTITION BY rh.NodeID, rh.PapoID, rh.RegisterCode
				            ORDER BY rh.Timestamp DESC
				        ) AS rn
				    FROM registerhistory rh
				    INNER JOIN node n ON n.ID = rh.NodeID
				    INNER JOIN papo p ON p.ID = rh.PapoID
				    INNER JOIN workstation w ON w.ID = rh.WorkstationID
				),
				
				-- Registros de inicio de turno (tipo 7)
				start_records AS (
				    SELECT 
				        rh.NodeID,
				        rh.PapoID,
				        rh.RegisterCode,
				        rh.Timestamp AS StartTime
				    FROM registerhistory rh
				    WHERE rh.RegisterTypeID = 7
				),
				
				-- Emparejar cada registro con su StartTime (máximo previo o igual)
				joined_start AS (
				    SELECT 
				        r.RegisterID,
				        MAX(s.StartTime) AS StartTime
				    FROM ranked r
				    LEFT JOIN start_records s
				        ON r.NodeID = s.NodeID
				        AND r.PapoID = s.PapoID
				        AND r.RegisterCode = s.RegisterCode
				        AND s.StartTime <= r.Timestamp
				    GROUP BY r.RegisterID
				)
				
				SELECT 
				    r.RegisterID,
				    r.Timestamp,
				    r.Status,
				    r.[User],
				    r.DataAnswer,
				    r.RegisterTypeID,
				    r.RegisterCode,
				    r.NodeID,
				    r.NodeName,
				    r.NodeDisplayName,
				    r.Path,
				    r.PapoID,
				    r.PapoReference,
				    r.PapoDescription,
				    r.WorkstationNodeID,
				    r.WorkstationID,
				    r.WorkstationDescription,
				    j.StartTime
				FROM ranked r
				LEFT JOIN joined_start j ON r.RegisterID = j.RegisterID
				WHERE r.rn = 1
				    AND r.Status != 'Sin iniciar'
				ORDER BY r.Timestamp DESC
        """
	
	ds = system.db.runQuery(query ,database = self.custom.dbConnection)
	
	date = system.date.now()  # devuelve java.util.Date
	
	for i in range(ds.getRowCount()):
		status = ds.getValueAt(i, "Status")
		#logger.info('Status : {}'.format(status))
		if status == "En proceso":
			startDate = ds.getValueAt(i, "StartTime")  # también es java.util.Date
			# Diferencia en milisegundos
			if startDate is None:
				startDate = date
			diff_ms = date.getTime() - startDate.getTime()
			# Convertir a minutos
			diff_min = diff_ms / 60000.0
			#logger.info('En proceso {}'.format(str(diff_min)))
			# ejemplo: validar si es mayor a 180 min (3 h)
			if int(diff_min) > 180:
				#logger.info('Firmo el formulario')
				dbConnection = self.view.custom.dbConnection
				user = 'NA'
				name = 'NA'
				lastname = 'NA'
				role = ['Administrator','Supervisor']
				papoID = ds.getValueAt(i, "PapoID")
				nodeID = ds.getValueAt(i, "NodeID")
				registerTypeID = 10
				registerCode = ds.getValueAt(i, "RegisterCode")
				status = 'Revisado'
				workStationNodeID = ds.getValueAt(i, "WorkstationNodeID")
				workStationID = ds.getValueAt(i, "WorkstationID")
				
				# --- convertir a JSON string ---
				dataAnswer = {
					"user": user,
					"role": list(role),
					"name": name,
					"lastname": lastname
				}
				dataAnswerStr = system.util.jsonEncode(dataAnswer)
				
				sql = """
					INSERT INTO registerhistory 
					(Timestamp, DataAnswer, Status, PapoID, RegisterTypeID, [User], WorkstationNodeID, NodeID, WorkstationID, RegisterCode)
					VALUES (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
				"""
				
				# Parámetros en el mismo orden de VALUES
				args = [
					dataAnswerStr,
					status,
					papoID,
					registerTypeID,
					user,
					workStationNodeID,
					nodeID,
					workStationID,
					registerCode
				]
				
				# Ejecutar insert
				system.db.runPrepUpdate(sql, args, dbConnection)
				#logger.info('Firmo el formulario {}')
				#logger.info('Firmo')
		else:
			pass
	return ds

# startTime
	
	"""
	Transforms the provided date value based on user-selected options for 
	period and shift.
	
	Args:
	    value (Date): The date value to transform.
	    quality (Quality): The quality of the data (not used in this function).
	    timestamp (Timestamp): The timestamp of the value (not used in this function).
	
	Returns:
	    Date: The transformed date based on the selected options.
	"""
	
	def set_datetime(year, month, day, hour):
		"""Helper function to set the date and time."""
		date = system.date.getDate(year, month, day)
		return system.date.setTime(date, hour, 0, 0)
	"""
	# Test hour
	value = set_datetime(2024, 9, 22, 7)
	print value
	shift = "A"
	dropDownPeriod = 5  # 0: Turno A, 1: Turno B, 2: Turno C, 3: Previous Day, 4: Current Day, 5: Weeks, 6: Months, 7: Custom
	startTime = set_datetime(2020, 10, 2, 21)
	"""
	year = system.date.getYear(value)
	month = system.date.getMonth(value)
	day = system.date.getDayOfMonth(value)
	hour = system.date.getHour24(value)
	dayOfWeek = system.date.getDayOfWeek(value)
	#print dayOfWeek
	
	# Variables to hold user selections
	dropDownPeriod = self.getChild("root").getChild("Filters").getChild("Dropdown Periodo").props.value
	shift = self.custom.shift
	startTime = self.getChild("root").getChild("Filters").getChild("DateTimeInput_StartTime").props.value
	
	# Process the selected period
	if dropDownPeriod != 7:  # Assuming '7' represents a custom option
		if dropDownPeriod == 4:  # Current Day
			# Use current day's start time if after 6 AM; otherwise, use the previous day's
			newDate = set_datetime(year, month, day if hour >= 6 else day - 1, 6)
			value = newDate
	
		elif dropDownPeriod == 3:  # Previous Day
			# Use the previous day's start time based on current hour
			newDate = set_datetime(year, month, day - (1 if hour >= 6 else 2), 6)
			value = newDate
			
		elif dropDownPeriod == -1:  # No specific selection (consider using a different value)
			value = set_datetime(year, month, day, hour)
			
		elif dropDownPeriod == 6:  # Months
			value = set_datetime(year, month, 1, 6)
		
		elif dropDownPeriod == 5:  # Weeks
			# Calculate the day of the week (1: Sunday, 7: Saturday)
			dayOfWeek = system.date.getDayOfWeek(system.date.getDate(year, month, day))
		
			# Calculate the previous Monday
			if dayOfWeek == 2:  # If it is Monday (Day 2)	
				if hour >= 6:
					previousMonday = system.date.addDays(system.date.getDate(year, month, day), -dayOfWeek + 2)
				else:
					# Go back one week (7 days)
					previousMonday = system.date.addDays(system.date.getDate(year, month, day), -7)
		    
	
			elif dayOfWeek > 2:
				previousMonday = system.date.addDays(system.date.getDate(year, month, day), -dayOfWeek + 2)
				
			else:
				previousMonday = system.date.addDays(system.date.getDate(year, month, day), -6)
		
			# Set the time to 6:00:00
			value = set_datetime(system.date.getYear(previousMonday), system.date.getMonth(previousMonday), system.date.getDayOfMonth(previousMonday), 6)
		    
		# Shift logic
		if shift == 'C':
			if dropDownPeriod == 2:  # Selecting Shift C while in Shift C
				newHour = 14 
				value = set_datetime(year, month, day, newHour)
	
			elif dropDownPeriod == 0:  # Selecting Shift A while in Shift C
				newHour = 22
				value = set_datetime(year, month, day-1, newHour)
	
			elif dropDownPeriod == 1:  # Selecting Shift B while in Shift C
				newHour = 6
				value = set_datetime(year, month, day, newHour)
	
		elif shift == 'B':
			if dropDownPeriod == 0:  # Selecting Shift A while in Shift B
				value = set_datetime(year, month, day-1, 22)
	
			elif dropDownPeriod == 2:  # Selecting Shift C while in Shift B
				value = set_datetime(year, month, day - 1, 14)
	
			elif dropDownPeriod == 1:  # Selecting Shift B while in Shift B
				value = set_datetime(year, month, day, 6)
	
		elif shift == 'A':
			if dropDownPeriod == 1:  # Selecting Shift B while in Shift A
				if hour < 6:
					day1 = day-1
				else:
					day1 = day
				value = set_datetime(year, month, day1, 6)
	
			elif dropDownPeriod == 0:  # Selecting Shift A while in Shift A
				if hour < 6:
					day1 = day-1
				else:
					day1 = day
				value = set_datetime(year, month, day1, 22)
	
			elif dropDownPeriod == 2:  # Selecting Shift C while in Shift A
				if hour < 6:
					day1 = day-1
				else:
					day1 = day
				value = set_datetime(year, month, day1, 14)
	else:
		# If the dropdown period is 7, use the start time as the value
		value = startTime
	return value

"""
	Filter Line and Papo dropdowns based on selected Area.
	If Area is cleared, reload all lines and papos.
	"""
	logger = system.util.getLogger("gestion/dropdownArea")
	
	# Read value directly from dropdown
	areaId = self.props.value
	dbConnection = self.view.custom.dbConnection
	
	# Normalize empty values
	if not areaId:
		areaId = None
	
	# logger.info("Area changed to: %s" % str(areaId))
	
	# Clear dependent dropdowns FIRST (before loading data)
	self.getSibling("Dropdown Station").props.value = ''
	self.getSibling("Dropdown Papo").props.value = ''
	
	# Small delay to let the clearing complete
	import time
	time.sleep(0.1)
	
	if areaId is not None:
		# Filter lines by selected area
		dataLine = sql.line(nodeId=areaId, db=dbConnection)
		if dataLine is not None:
			self.view.custom.dataLine = dataLine
		
		# Filter papos by selected area
		dataPapo = sql.papoByArea(areaId=areaId, db=dbConnection)
		if dataPapo is not None:
			self.view.custom.dataPapo = dataPapo
			# logger.info("Loaded %d papos for area %s" % (dataPapo.rowCount, str(areaId)))
	else:
		# No area selected - show all lines and papos
		dataLine = sql.lineAll(dbConnection)
		if dataLine is not None:
			self.view.custom.dataLine = dataLine
		
		dataPapo = sql.papoAll(dbConnection)
		if dataPapo is not None:
			self.view.custom.dataPapo = dataPapo
			# logger.info("Loaded %d papos (all)" % dataPapo.rowCount)
	
	# Refresh table
	system.perspective.sendMessage('filterTable')

"""
	Filter Papo dropdown based on selected Line.
	If Line is cleared but Area is selected, filter by Area.
	If neither is selected, show all papos.
	"""
	logger = system.util.getLogger("gestion/dropdownStation")
	
	# Read value directly from dropdown
	lineId = self.props.value
	dbConnection = self.view.custom.dbConnection
	
	# Get area value from sibling dropdown
	areaDropdown = self.getSibling("Dropdown Area")
	areaId = areaDropdown.props.value
	
	# Normalize empty values
	if not lineId:
		lineId = None
	if not areaId:
		areaId = None
	
	# logger.info("Line changed to: %s, Area is: %s" % (str(lineId), str(areaId)))
	
	# Clear papo dropdown FIRST
	self.getSibling("Dropdown Papo").props.value = ''
	
	if lineId is not None:
		# Filter papos by selected line
		dataPapo = sql.papoByNode(nodeId=lineId, db=dbConnection)
		if dataPapo is not None and dataPapo.rowCount > 0:
			self.view.custom.dataPapo = dataPapo
			# logger.info("Loaded %d papos for line %s" % (dataPapo.rowCount, str(lineId)))
		elif areaId is not None:
			# Line has no papos, fall back to area filter
			dataPapo = sql.papoByArea(areaId=areaId, db=dbConnection)
			if dataPapo is not None:
				self.view.custom.dataPapo = dataPapo
		else:
			# Line has no papos and no area, show all
			dataPapo = sql.papoAll(dbConnection)
			if dataPapo is not None:
				self.view.custom.dataPapo = dataPapo
	elif areaId is not None:
		# No line but area selected - filter by area
		dataPapo = sql.papoByArea(areaId=areaId, db=dbConnection)
		if dataPapo is not None:
			self.view.custom.dataPapo = dataPapo
			# logger.info("Loaded %d papos for area %s" % (dataPapo.rowCount, str(areaId)))

		# Nothing selected - show all papos

		if dataPapo is not None:
			self.view.custom.dataPapo = dataPapo
			# logger.info("Loaded %d papos (all)" % dataPapo.rowCount)
	
	# Refresh table
	system.perspective.sendMessage('filterTable')

	dbConnection = self.view.custom.dbConnection
	user = self.session.props.auth.user.userName
	name = self.session.props.auth.user.firstName
	lastname = self.session.props.auth.user.lastName
	role = self.session.props.auth.user.roles
	
	# --- normalizar valores numéricos (sacar .value de los ObjectWrapper) ---
	papoID = self.view.custom.selection.PapoID
	nodeID = self.view.custom.selection.NodeID
	registerTypeID = 10
	registerCode = self.view.custom.selection.RegisterCode
	status = 'Revisado'
	workStationNodeID = self.view.custom.selection.WorkstationNodeID
	workStationID = self.view.custom.selection.WorkstationID
	
	# --- convertir a JSON string ---
	dataAnswer = {
		"user": user,
		"role": list(role),
		"name": name,
		"lastname": lastname
	}
	dataAnswerStr = system.util.jsonEncode(dataAnswer)

	# Consulta SQL
	sql = """
		INSERT INTO registerhistory 
		(Timestamp, DataAnswer, Status, PapoID, RegisterTypeID, [User], WorkstationNodeID, NodeID, WorkstationID, RegisterCode)
		VALUES (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
	"""

	# Parámetros en el mismo orden de VALUES
	args = [
		dataAnswerStr,
		status,
		papoID,
		registerTypeID,
		user,
		workStationNodeID,
		nodeID,
		workStationID,
		registerCode
	]

	# Ejecutar insert
	system.db.runPrepUpdate(sql, args, dbConnection)
	
	alerts.actionSuccess('Formulario firmado', message='El formulario fue firmado correctamente')
	logger.info('Formulario Firmado')
	system.perspective.sendMessage('filterTable')
	self.getChild("FlexContainer").getChild("FlexContainer").getChild("Table").props.selection.selectedRow = 0
	self.view.custom.refreshPDF = self.view.custom.refreshPDF+1
